profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
XML and data standards expert.  
Experience with XML Schema design, validation, & tools.
Experience with development of standards, standards development organizations & national and international standards bodies.
Experience organizing data workflow solutions.
Developed strategy and feasibility affecting complex data systems and architectures
Identify challenging customer issues and develop advanced solutions to support customer requirements
Transformed business processes, and policies into working solutions.
Experience developing project plans, defining project goals, and tasks.
Excellent verbal and written communications and problem solving skills
Comfortable working with senior management and customer leadership.
Experience in Systems Engineering, System Design, Software Development, Testing and documentation.
Experience with relational database modeling, Object-Oriented design techniques, & Unified Modeling Language (UML).
Experience in testing, verifying, & integrating system requirements.
Experience with Agile development techniques.
Familiarity with open source products and tools.
IoT Enthusiast

positions.title: Principle Engineer
positions.description:
On-site technical support for EMS products at US Army TACOM in Warren, MI.
Principle Support Engineer for EMS2 content developers and IETM users.
Trained Government and Industry OEM IETM developers to use EMS2 software and to develop IETM content.
Software Developer – Developed custom authoring system using JavaScript and native Abortext Command Language (ACL).
Developed and Presented IETM Technical Briefings to industry and government officials.

positions.title: Principle Engineer
positions.description:
On-site technical support for EMS products at US Army TACOM in Warren, MI.
Principle Support Engineer for EMS2 content developers and IETM users.
Provided support to US Army and DOD contractor in the creation and maintenance of EMS IETMs.
Developed and Presented IETM Technical Briefings to industry and government officials.

positions.title: Associate Engineer
positions.description:
Provided On-Site Technical Services at the US Army National Training Center Ft Irwin, CA accompanying deployed training units on field exercises, assisted with and trained EMS2 IETM usage.
Trained Government and Industry OEM IETM developers to use EMS2 software and to develop IETM content.
IETM Technical Writer – create diagnostic fault procedures for US Army and US Marine Corps tactical vehicle electronic control systems.
Developed Software to implement Standard Generalized Markup Language (SGML) authoring system as EMS evolved into a standards based system.
Project Manager IETM development. Managed and scheduled IETM authoring activities; prepared work assignments, set production goals and monitored progress
